messages:
maria: FYI we flipped strict fncall validation on canary eu-west and rejects jumped to ~6% (baseline ~0.4%). not convinced it's just input drift.

josh: link to chart and a few reject examples? is this rejects vs reroutes vs degen?

maria: https://console.redwood.internal/d/validators/euwest?panel=fncall_rejects (slice=canary-eu). metric is validator.rejects and fallback->degen_count also rose. example from sampled trace:
```json
{"tool_response": ["ok","done"], "validation_error": "expected object for tool_response, got array"}
```

kevin: that explains it 5 some upstream adapters return arrays not objects. key question: are rejects attributed to original route or to the post-validate degen route in telemetry/billing?

sara: traces show billing keeps original route_id but console panels surface final route_tag (degen). customers see charges on original route while UI highlights degen path 5 confusing.

rollout-bot: Canary 'strict-validate-v2' (eu-west) auto-paused (reject_rate > 2.5% for 3/5 mins).

maria: do not unpause until we have two things: (1) reject_reason histogram with human labels + link to sampled traces per top bucket in the rollout panel; (2) explicit billing attribution flag in rollout UI and billing dashboard (are rejects billable?).

josh: notes: logs currently emit validator.code (machine token). UI needs human labels like TOOL_SHAPE_ARRAY_INSTEAD_OF_OBJ. trace sampling is 1/100 for rejects; recommend 1/10 for canary for 2 hrs to collect examples.

kevin: infra plan: add a normalizer in validation pipeline to emit canonical reject_reason strings; ship behind feature flag. add header X-Validate-Sample:1 to force sampling. will also emit original_route_id + final_route_tag in validation logs to disambiguate.

sara: UX: show two counters in rollout detail: "rejects (original route)" and "rejects (post-validate fallback)" so we can tell validator vs routing issues.

maria: filing PLAT-3401: "euwest strict-validate follow-up: reject_reason histogram + trace links + billing attribution". assign @josh @kevin @sara @support. acceptance: human-label histogram, trace link for top N buckets, side-by-side counters, and billing flag showing whether rejects are billable.

josh: i'll prototype the histogram and trace-link component today using diag-panel.

kevin: i'll implement the normalizer and sampling header behind a flag and test on canary slice.

sara: added sample traces to PLAT-3401 for QA and cc'ed support for customer comms.

maria: TL;DR: keep strict-validate paused in eu-west until histogram + traces + billing attribution are in place. quick sync in 15m in #eng-platform if available. :thumbsup:
